source: 2df1664 plus the native ideal-machine clock (native-clock-v1) and audio content comparison

levels.2: passing isolated unit or differential tests
levels.4: verified against the original DOS executable in a stated domain (three-way, scenario level)

notes: Levels are the highest level reached inside the stated domain; a subsystem can be level 2 for isolated routines and still level 5 at scenario level. Both are given.

Scenario checks run natively against references recorded once per DOS executable (build/reference/, portable/tests/acceptance/step_check.py, seconds per scenario). Native replays each DOS run's own per-site clock values and its chronological service order (clock reads, BIOS keyboard samples, queue-count samples, pumps, simulation boundaries); each recorded input is admitted at its recorded service position through the ordinary SDL adapter. The canonical lane (native vs canonical DOS) tests the port, the original lane tests the whole chain. Verdicts are game state per DoAntSim entry. The handler-entry CX/DX a keyboard IRQ copies into its event (on DOS the wrapper's DGROUP residue) is replayed from the tape as part of the interrupt. Since contract v5 the DOS recorder holds each scripted input until the next recorded service boundary and raises it there, so native placement is exact; inputs arriving mid-raster (outcome depends on CPU speed) are outside the tested domain. Since v6, device-status answers that depend on hardware timing (sound driver: song/sample done) are recorded in the service order and replayed like clock reads. Since v7, the indexed 640x480 frame, attribute map and full 256-entry DAC are recorded at checkpoint entries (entry 1, every 256, the last) and compared exactly with native; the game's software cursor is part of both frames. Each lane has three verdicts: game state (stops at the first difference), checkpoint frames, and audio (MIDI/voice progress views, does not stop the state comparison). Since v8 the sound timer ISR completions are recorded in the service order and native executes its converted ISR exactly that many times at the same boundary; raw OPL/DSP/DMA OUT streams are compared per entry in the audio verdict.
Open findings are pinned per lane in portable/tests/acceptance/known_findings.json; the upper-layer test fails on any change in either direction.
